about_the_game:
Melodies of the Orchestra, Resonance of Song

A luxurious orchestral arrangement album celebrating the 10th anniversary of the NieR series!

In 2020, marking a decade since the release of NieR Gestalt/Replicant, this special album was created to commemorate the milestone with newly arranged orchestral renditions of iconic tracks. Featuring carefully selected pieces from NieR Gestalt/Replicant and NieR:Automata, the album brings the series' unforgettable melodies to life in a grand orchestral setting.

Additionally, some tracks include stunning vocal performances by Emi Evans and J’Nique Nicole.

Immerse yourself in this anniversary-worthy, breathtaking NieR music experience!
